tlb_eur.label: New term loan, EURm equivalent

fx.label: SEK per EUR, constant translation proxy

margin.label: Starting EBITDA margin proxy
margin.basis: Middle of agency's 25-27% outlook; not reported margin

cash_haircut.label: Adjusted EBITDA to cash EBITDA haircut
cash_haircut.basis: 5% reserve for noncash/addback leakage; requires reconciliation

opening_cash.label: Opening cash proxy
opening_cash.basis: Unverified opening liquidity; sensitise before any approval

base_rate.label: Reference rate proxy
base_rate.basis: Constant illustrative blended funding rate; not current EURIBOR/SOFR

spread.label: New term-loan spread proxy
spread.basis: Illustrative 400bp; not carried from the legacy loan or verified pricing

amort.label: Annual term-loan amortisation
amort.basis: 1% of original principal; loan documentation required

sweep.label: Excess cash sweep
sweep.basis: Repay RCF first; sweep half residual above cash buffer to TLB

tax.label: Illustrative blended cash tax rate
tax.basis: Simplified 22% cash tax; not legal tax advice or group effective tax rate

transaction_cost.label: 2026 agency transaction-cost forecast
transaction_cost.basis: SP26: one-off costs; deducted once in 2026

nwc.label: Working capital investment / revenue change
nwc.basis: Inventory/receivable funding; release allowed on falling sales

max_leverage.label: Underwriting gross leverage ceiling
max_leverage.basis: Credit policy proxy, not a contractual covenant

min_cover.label: Underwriting cash interest cover floor
min_cover.basis: Cash EBITDA / interest plus commitment fee

recovery_haircut.label: Default EBITDA haircut

recovery_multiple.label: Default enterprise-value multiple

recovery_cost.label: Enforcement costs / stressed EV

recovery_rcf_draw.label: Revolver drawn at default
